blocks.text: BEIJING, China—China has eradicated “serious hidden dangers” in its Communist Party and military under President Xi Jinping’s leadership, a senior official said on Friday. The statement comes a day after authorities confirmed the expulsion of a record 33 figures. In more than a decade in charge, Xi has cracked down hard on graft, ensnaring thousands of officials, and purging dozens of members of the powerful Central Committee and a string of top military brass.
